title: Walfos Fine Mesh Strainers Set, Premium Stainless Steel Colanders and Sifters, with Reinforced Frame Sturdy Handle, Perfect for Sift, Strain, Drain Rinse Vegetables, Pastas Tea - 3 Sizes
description:
About this item
SEAL STEEL RING, LONG HANDLE: All sizes of fine mesh strainer feature a sturdy wire frame and have rust-proof screens, securely attached long handle increase the loading capacity and protect you from scalding when removing the noodles from boiling water
3 MOST POPULAR SIZES: 2.8" strainer for tea, quinoa or coffee, 4.7" strainer for powder sugar, cocoa powder, and 7.87" strainer for quinoa, pasta, A kitchen must have all your straining, sieving, sifting, filtering and rinsing tasks
NO WASTED FOOD: The strainers fine mesh nets easily catch and sift, strain or drain the small ingredients. The sealed steel rims also prevent food from getting trapped between the mesh and the rim
EASY TO CLEAN: Our strainers and colanders are made of long-lasting stainless steel, Just need to be cleaned in time, soft food will not stick to the hard stainless steel. Place the strainers for kitchen in the water and shake it gently
EASY TO USE AND STORE: Easy to hold with the handle, and convenient to use. Also it is easy to hang the sifter for baking on a hook for storage, keeping your kitchen clean and tidy all the time
